decisions.change: Show discovery screens and flows without execution controls, with equal-weight print-label and QR draft paths. Distinguish reached draft states from submission and independent verification.
Explain blocked read-only draft writes and incomplete initial item/reason exploration rather than claiming comprehensive verification.
Keep item instructions fixed, expose only supported reason and method choices, retain original-payment intent, and render fees and refunds exclusively from current task values.
Separate requested choices from observed terms, surface destination and selection conflicts, and provide explicit Validate and Restore controls without approval or submission actions.
Use labeled native selects, readable forest-on-cream colors, visible keyboard focus, responsive layouts, and live status announcements. Disable actions while work or receipt locks are present.
